items: [Multi-Compartment Design for Organization] This stylish crossbody bag features 4 zippered compartments, including a main compartment (with 1 zippered pocket + 2 slip pockets), 2 front zippered pockets, and 1 back zippered pocket. The spacious yet compact layout keeps your essentials neatly organized for daily use

[Anti-Theft Zippers for Added Security] Equipped with secure, anti-theft zippers, this purse deters pickpockets and keeps your belongings safe while traveling or commuting. Enjoy peace of mind during outings or trips

[Premium Faux Leather & Durable Hardware] Crafted from high-quality, odor-free faux leather and sturdy metal accents, this lightweight bag is soft, scratch-resistant, and easy to clean. The sleek finish ensures long-lasting durability

[Adjustable & Versatile Strap] Includes a removable, adjustable shoulder strap (23.62–47.24 inches) with a trendy printed design. It also has a cute tassel decoration, adding a touch of playfulness to the bag. Wear it as a crossbody shoulder bag, or even use it as a spacious wallet for minimalist outings

Compact & Fashionable Measuring 9.85 x 3.15 x 7.08 inches(L*W*H), this chic small purse combines functionality with a vibrant, modern look. Perfect as a gift for Christmas, Valentine’s Day, birthdays, or anniversaries—ideal for daily use or vacation
